boundedQuestion: Can a fresh page, exact head and passing browser run prove the requested latest total-platform human when the subject is composite but only one aggregate R07 label is frozen?
answer: No. Artifact freshness and route identity prove which page ran; they do not prove that body, skin, head, hair, eyebrows, eyes, mouth, rig and motion equal the dispatch-time intended component set.
requiredDeliveryReceiptIncrement: actualRuntimeSubjectComponents with immutable source identity per component
mustNever: A monolithic version label is expanded into proof that every visible and behavioral component is current.
A fresh commit or browser run is expanded into proof that the runtime loaded the user-requested composite subject.
Latest specialist branches are silently promoted when the Human owner has not resolved a canonical component set.
An explicitly user-frozen older subject is rejected merely because a newer specialist candidate exists.
Machine component matching is expanded into visual acceptance or production readiness.
activationGate: Run once on the next relevant Human candidate after the Human owner resolves the dispatch-time expected component set. Independent verifier must compare the runtime component inventory. Coordinator review is required before any global field change.
rollback: Remove this evidence extension and fields only. Do not modify NPC R04, current Human assets, production branches, or any user-frozen baseline.
